name: NextAdmin
summary: Open-source Next.js admin dashboard template with 200+ components and AI-agent context files.
description: Product Hunt page for NextAdmin: a free, open-source Next.js admin dashboard with 200+ UI components, six prebuilt dashboards (analytics, e-commerce, CRM, marketing), AGENTS.md rules, agent skills and a prompt library, plus a Figma design source. The core is MIT; Pro adds more components and premium skills as a one-time payment.
